_comment: TEMPLATE for the reserved RAPIER block (PREP.md 'Adding the Rapier rows'). Copy to rows9a.extra.json and edit; the driver merges it over rows9a.json at start (binaries by key, rows by id, blocks by name, ordered by priority). Fill every '<FILL: ...>' from D:/tmp/rapier-parity/window9a_rows.md; a '<FILL' left in place makes the gate and the driver RED (the pose_hash check cannot pass), it never passes silently. The exe must also get a line in bin/SHA256SUMS and its sha256 in sha256_pin. Keys shown are the ones the 2026-09-30 pre-fix harness prints (SUMMARY: engine, cfg, install, workers, target_env, void, voids, threads.pool_threads_min/max, pose_hash, receipt_gates, rapier_version). PLACEMENT (audit-1 W2; each claim below is a selftest9a case over the driver's own --dry-run): the block priority orders BLOCKS (3.5 = after C4-BR, before C4-G4; 4.5 would run it AFTER C4-G4; 0.5 first). A row's position INSIDE a shared block is the row-list order; an overlay row is appended, i.e. it is the LAST cell of every W group (after C4-JDpar#parent at W1/2/4, after C4-rung#tip at W8/16: never next to C4-JD#tip). To choose the neighbour, give the NEW row "insert_after": "<row id>" (see the note on the row).

rapier.commit: <FILL: rapier-parity source state, e.g. the SOURCES.sha256 line>
rapier.what: Rapier 0.36 parity harness, simd8 arm, run by path

expect_summary.pose_hash: <FILL: the final-pose hash window9a_rows.md gives for this cfg (identical at every W for the simd8 arm)>

rows.note: one row per cfg: copy this row for rapier-default (id RAP-default, --cfg rapier-default, its own pose_hash). Two placements. (A) Own block, as here (priority 3.5): the Rapier cells run in their own passes with their own warm-up, K 9; the block's cells are RAP-* only. (B) Inside C4-AB, next to J-D each round: drop the block above, set "blocks": ["C4-AB"] and "insert_after": "C4-jolt56" - the row then sits BETWEEN C4-jolt56#j56 and C4-JD#tip at every W (1/2/4/8/16), mirrored in a reversed pass. The cost is stated, not hidden: Jolt and J-D#tip stop being neighbours (Jolt keeps its J-T#tip neighbour at W1/8/16; at W2/4, where no J-T cell exists, Jolt is then next to no J-D / J-T cell). insert_after C4-JD instead would break the merge-gate pair J-D / J-Dap. Without insert_after the row is appended: the last cell of every W group, next to C4-JDpar#parent (W1/2/4) or C4-rung#tip (W8/16). Rapier shares C4-AB's K 9 and passes in (B).
